test_scenario_registration: test that scenarios are properly registered in the ScenarioRegistry using the register decorator
test_get_all_scenarios: test that get_all_scenarios returns all registered scenarios and triggers lazy loading discovery
test_get_scenario: test that get_scenario retrieves the correct scenario class by its scenario_id from the registry
test_lazy_loading: test that scenarios are only discovered on first request via the lazy-loading mechanism
test_scenario_id_propagation: test that the scenario_id set during registration is propagated to instances of the scenario class
